name: liefero
description: Liefero — multi-vertical on-demand delivery marketplace for Germany and the EU

scripts.build: npm run build -w @liefero/shared && npm run build -w @liefero/api
scripts.test: npm run build -w @liefero/shared && npm test -w @liefero/shared && npm test -w @liefero/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @liefero/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
